themes.title: Immigration Restriction Rhetoric Spreads Across Europe
themes.blurb: Right‑wing parties in France, Norway and Sweden are echoing each other’s calls for stricter immigration controls, linking demographic concerns to cultural threats. The narrative ties tighter borders to national security and economic stability, showing a coordinated framing across national lines.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen’s plan to enshrine a fiscal "golden rule" is coupled with anti‑immigration messaging, warning of cultural dilution.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Party warns that non‑Western immigration could rise 36% by 2040, urging stricter policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Local questioning of the party’s achievements reflects a broader focus on immigration impact on communities.
